question: Should ClawRouter core own a default-off `clawrouter/fusion` virtual model plus bundled local OpenAI-compatible provider after the concrete blockers are fixed?
rationale: The PR adds a new model-selection and provider-configuration surface that changes core routing behavior, so implementation correctness alone cannot decide whether this belongs in core.

options.title: Sponsor fusion in core after blockers
options.body: Accept the core direction, then require the readiness, pricing, preflight, proof, and rebase work before merge.

options.title: Narrow to provider support only
options.body: Keep the local OpenAI-compatible provider path but defer the virtual ensemble router until the product boundary is clearer.

options.title: Pause outside core
options.body: Decline this core PR for now and revisit fusion as a plugin or separate product proposal if the needed extension points are identified.

recommendation.title: Sponsor fusion in core after blockers
recommendation.body: Accept the core direction, then require the readiness, pricing, preflight, proof, and rebase work before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is the strongest current history match for the Worker data plane, provider readiness, and admin console surfaces involved in the decision.
